# rustinion_remote_access_operator (Resource)

Manages who may start remote sessions: an allow (a technician who may use a channel inside the organization or one group) or a deny (a person who may not; beats every allow). Organization admins may open the terminal and the desktop by default; anyone else needs an allow. You cannot change your own access, grant what you do not hold, or deny someone above you; the server enforces it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `effect` (String) `allow` or `deny`.
- `scope` (String) `tenant` or `group`.

### Optional

- `channel` (String) A channel name or `*` (every channel, the default; needs organization admin rights).
- `email` (String) The person's email. Give this or `user_id`.
- `scope_id` (String) The group id (omit for `tenant`).
- `user_id` (String) The person's user id (`rustinion_user.x.user_id`). Give this or `email`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned row id.
